notes: v1.14.549 — LEGACY-RETIRE STAGE 6.4: OPTICS IS DECOUPLED. The whole pg-fiber surface — the fiber strip and all eight fiber-sub panels, 930 lines — is now AUTHORED inside #rf-optics instead of being drained there at boot. redesign_homeOptics and its registration are deleted, the fourth of eight re-homes, and the pg-fiber shell goes with them. Moved programmatically, so all 930 lines are byte-identical and every id verbatim, because showStab and STAB_GROUPS[fiber-sub] resolve them by id. ⚠ The scaffold KEEPS its stab-active class: #rf-optics is the DEFAULT Reference panel, and dropping that class would open Tools on a blank Optics tab. The initSubtab binding stays for the same reason it stayed in 6.3 — the DOM move is gone but the binding is not, and authoring markup binds nothing. 📌 The re-home carried a standing note that the fiber strip cross-links to Hardware and CLI would need repointing when those re-homed. They did not: under the redesign showPage guard redirects cli to showRefTab(rf-cli) and power to rd_openPlatforms(), so both land correctly, and v1.14.548 made the legacy side say so instead of blanking. ⛔ VISIBLE UNDER ?legacy=1: the legacy house loses Optics, the fourth organ to go — and with pg-fiber goes the legacy stab that was 6.3s stranded CLI door, so that one resolved itself.
